Package com.example.volt.selected

Class SelectedDestinationsManager

java.lang.Object
com.example.volt.selected.SelectedDestinationsManager
All Implemented Interfaces:
OnItemAddedListener, OnItemDraggedListener, com.robotemi.sdk.listeners.OnGoToLocationStatusChangedListener
public class SelectedDestinationsManager extends Object implements OnItemDraggedListener, OnItemAddedListener, com.robotemi.sdk.listeners.OnGoToLocationStatusChangedListener
SelectedDestinationsManager is a link layer between DestinationCollection and SelectedDestinationsAdapter.

Representation Invariant:

  • recyclerView != null
  • recyclerViewAdapter != null
  • destinationCollection != null
  • goButton != null
  • goButton.enabled iff !destinationCollection.isEmpty()
  • destinationCollection.getDestinations == recyclerViewAdapter.getDataSet()
  • goToCommand != null

Abstraction Function:

SelectedDestinationsManager sdm represents a link between DestinationCollection and SelectedDestinationsAdapter such that:
  • sdm.recyclerView is the DragDropSwipeRecyclerView that displays Destinations.
  • sdm.recyclerViewAdapter is the SelectedDestinationsAdapter that links between the DestinationCollection and DragDropSwipeRecyclerView.
  • sdm.destinationCollection is the collection of Destinations to display.
  • sdm.goButton is the Button that starts the robot's movement.
  • sdm.goToCommand is the Command that represents the operation of sending the robot to a location.
